description: Provision a Google Cloud Dataform DataformRepository via Config Connector. Fields mirror the dataform.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 DataformRepository spec.

gitRemoteSettings.description: Optional. If set, configures this repository to be linked to a Git remote.

authenticationTokenSecretVersionRef.description: The name of the Secret Manager secret version to use as an authentication token for Git operations. Must be in the format projects/* /secrets/* /versions/*. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: If provided must be in the format `projects/*/secrets/*/versions/*`.

defaultBranch.description: The Git remote's default branch name.

sshAuthenticationConfig.description: Authentication fields for remote uris using SSH protocol.

hostPublicKey.description: Content of a public SSH key to verify an identity of a remote Git host.

userPrivateKeySecretVersionRef.description: The name of the Secret Manager secret version to use as a ssh private key for Git operations. Must be in the format projects/*/secrets/*/versions/* . Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: If provided must be in the format `projects/*/secrets/*/versions/*`.

npmrcEnvironmentVariablesSecretVersionRe.description: Optional. The name of the Secret Manager secret version to be used to interpolate variables into the .npmrc file for package installation operations. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: If provided must be in the format `projects/*/secrets/*/versions/*`.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

region.description: Immutable. A reference to the region.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

serviceAccountRef.description: Optional. The service account reference to run workflow invocations under. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

setAuthenticatedUserAdmin.description: Optional. Input only. If set to true, the authenticated user will be granted the roles/dataform.admin role on the created repository.

workspaceCompilationOverrides.description: Optional. If set, fields of workspaceCompilationOverrides override the default compilation settings that are specified in dataform.json when creating workspace-scoped compilation results.

defaultDatabase.description: Optional. The default database (Google Cloud project ID).

schemaSuffix.description: Optional. The suffix that should be appended to all schema (BigQuery dataset ID) names.

tablePrefix.description: Optional. The prefix that should be prepended to all table names.
